claim: The top-level evaluation architecture was stable between 2017-2020 and 2021-2024 in the three pilot areas.
evidence: Each pilot area retained 12 top-level items; no unmatched area-item IDs were detected.
interpretation_limit: This concerns top-level Ficha architecture only; lower-level indicators, operational definitions, and evaluation practice may still have changed.

claim: Top-level numerical weights were fully stable between 2017-2020 and 2021-2024 in the three pilot areas.
interpretation_limit: The result is limited to Psicologia, Química, and Saúde Coletiva and should not yet be generalized to all CAPES areas.

claim: The 2025-2028 model introduced a common structural reorganization in all three pilot areas.
evidence: 12 -> 10 top-level items per area; Q1 4 -> 3, Q2 5 -> 4, Q3 3 -> 3.
interpretation_limit: A lower number of top-level items does not by itself indicate less evaluative content.

claim: The 12-to-10 transition cannot be described as simple deletion of two criteria.
evidence: Among 12 historical items: 5 were reformulated, 4 retained, 1 absorbed, 1 redistributed below top level, and 1 split/reorganized.
interpretation_limit: These classifications derive from the validated pilot semantic crosswalk; some relations required bounded lower-level evidence.

claim: Weight redistribution across semantically comparable criteria was area-specific.
evidence: Among seven safe one-to-one relations, Psicologia showed both increases and decreases, whereas Saúde Coletiva showed increases or unchanged exact weights.
interpretation_limit: Only seven semantically safe one-to-one relations are included; complex split, consolidation, shared-target, and redistributed relations are excluded from simple item-level deltas.

claim: Química changed the semantics of top-level weighting in 2025-2028.
evidence: All seven safe relations changed from exact historical weights to current minimum thresholds.
interpretation_limit: A transition such as 35 to >=35 or 65 to >=60 cannot be interpreted as an unchanged weight or a numeric reduction in the same sense as exact-to-exact comparisons.

claim: The consolidation of historical items 1.1 and 1.2 into current item 1.1 reduced exact top-level allocation in Psicologia and Saúde Coletiva.
interpretation_limit: The same directional interpretation is not valid for Química because its current value is a minimum threshold.

claim: Academic/Professional differentiation changed across waves and areas rather than following one common direction.
evidence: Psicologia: 2 -> 2 -> 0 differentiated items; Química: 3 -> 3 -> 2; Saúde Coletiva: 0 -> 0 -> 2.
interpretation_limit: This describes differences in top-level weights/operators only, not broader distinctions between Academic and Professional evaluation procedures.
